'''Sia Norrin''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Corellia]], [[Kapp Zyman]] detonated bombs on the rocket tram's green line that found a route into [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. However, Sia and a group of mechanics were able to repair a second line that had been damaged during an Imperial attack, allowing the Republic forces an alternate route into [[Axial Park]].
